name: Creamy White Bean, Mushroom & Tomato Sauté with Sourdough Toast

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, and thinly slice mushrooms. Place in a medium bowl and set aside.
Peel, halve, and small dice onions; peel and mince garlic.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium yellow onions
6 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large pot over medium heat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion, garlic, and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 4-5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp thyme, dried
¾ tsp smoked paprika
¾ tsp crushed red pepper
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: When the onion is softened, add mushrooms to the pot. Cook, stirring occasionally, until mushrooms are tender, 6-8 minutes.
While the mushrooms are cooking, drain and rinse beans; set aside to drain further.
When the mushrooms are tender, add tomato paste to the pot. Continue to cook, stirring frequently, until fragrant, 2-3 minutes more.

Add beans, tomatoes, broth, and cream to the pot. Stir to combine bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat to low and simmer, stirring occasionally, until sauce has thickened, 5-6 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (398 ml) cans diced tomatoes
237 ml chicken or vegetable broth
355 ml heavy whipping cream

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven. (Skip this step if you are using a toaster for the bread.)

Arrange bread on a large baking sheet pan. Place in the oven and broil, flipping halfway through, until lightly toasted, 1-2 minutes. Remove from oven and cut in half. (Alternatively, you can use a toaster.)
Divide sauté between plates or bowls. Serve with toast on the side and enjoy!
